Ishita Verma
Senior Frontend Engineer | Bengaluru
ishita.verma837@example.com | +91 9132291234

Experienced frontend engineer focused on building scalable, accessible user interfaces with a strong emphasis on component-driven design and maintainable CSS. Comfortable shipping high-quality UI libraries and consumer-facing features through test-driven development and cross-functional collaboration. Open to relocating to Delhi NCR. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience

Cognizant, May 2024 - Present
Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote/Onsite)
- Led redesign of a client-facing dashboard using React and Storybook, delivering a reusable component library of 120+ components and reducing UI development time by 40% through consistent patterns.
- Implemented responsive layouts and utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS and CSS variables, improving Core Web Vitals LCP by 18% across key pages.
- Built and documented interactive component demos in Storybook, enabling QA and designers to validate flows and decreasing UI bugs reported post-release by 35%.
- Integrated Git-based component versioning and CI checks, ensuring style and accessibility rules were enforced before merges.

Zentrix Labs, Sep 2023 - Apr 2024
React Developer (Contract)
- Developed customer onboarding flows in React and TypeScript, implementing form validation and error handling that reduced submission errors by 25%.
- Wrote unit and integration tests with Jest covering 85% of new features, catching regressions early and stabilizing weekly releases.
- Implemented design system tokens with Tailwind CSS and CSS modules to enable rapid theming across three products, decreasing theming effort by 60%.
- Collaborated via Git to run feature branches and PR reviews, improving merge velocity while maintaining code quality.

Helio Energy, Jun 2023 - Aug 2023
Frontend Engineer (Contract)
- Built interactive energy-monitoring widgets in React with Tailwind CSS, increasing user engagement on the analytics page by 22%.
- Optimized component styles and CSS to reduce bundle size and improve render performance, cutting first-render time by 15%.
- Created reusable UI components and documented usage patterns to speed up integration across product teams.
- Managed Git workflows and coordinated with backend engineers to ensure smooth API integration and predictable releases.

Finlytics, Sep 2018 - May 2023
UI Engineer (Onsite)
- Designed and implemented a modular UI system using Tailwind CSS and Storybook, enabling product teams to assemble dashboards 3x faster.
- Built a Storybook-driven component catalog with interactive examples and accessibility notes, reducing design-to-dev misalignment by 50%.
- Drove CSS refactor that removed legacy styles and reduced stylesheet size by 40%, improving page responsiveness for complex financial dashboards.
- Mentored junior engineers on component patterns, Git branching strategies, and Storybook best practices to raise overall frontend quality.

Skills
Languages: TypeScript
Frameworks/Libraries: React, Storybook
Testing: Jest
Styling: CSS, Tailwind CSS
Tools: Git

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
